subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should a configured TTS provider such as ElevenLabs fail closed/stay sticky after selection, or may OpenClaw continue falling back to other configured providers when that provider fails or is skipped?
rationale: Current docs and tests preserve fallback as supported behavior, so changing it affects compatibility and needs maintainer product intent rather than a narrow source-only repair.

options.title: Preserve fallback by default with explicit strict behavior
options.body: Keep the documented fallback chain for existing users and add or define a narrow opt-in sticky/fail-closed policy only if maintainers want that behavior.

options.title: Make configured providers fail closed
options.body: Change normal configured-provider TTS to stop after the selected provider fails or is skipped, accepting an upgrade behavior change for users who rely on fallback audio.

options.title: Keep diagnostics-only behavior
options.body: Leave current fallback behavior as-is and close the remaining provider-stickiness expectation as not planned after documenting the rationale.

recommendation.title: Preserve fallback by default with explicit strict behavior
recommendation.body: Keep the documented fallback chain for existing users and add or define a narrow opt-in sticky/fail-closed policy only if maintainers want that behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the fallback diagnostics work and already framed the remaining scope as provider-selection policy in the issue discussion.
